2.2.1.8. Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config.railyard_attributes_filter¶

property Config.railyard_attributes_filter¶

The set of attributes to filter out in the railyard dump. Defaults to the following attributes set by iLock_Geography:

  • LAYOUT_EDITOR_OBJECT

  • X_COORD

  • Y_COORD

Return type:

{string}
